policy: Maintained security minimums for the supported release lines. This complements, never replaces, npm audit/Dependabot and vendor advisories.

next.reason: Next.js September 30, 2026 security release; Active LTS patched floor addressing one High, five Medium and one Low severity vulnerabilities

react.reason: React Server Components security floor for the 19.2 line

react-dom.reason: Keep React DOM aligned with the patched React line

better-auth.reason: Better Auth v1.7.7 security release (2026-09-30); fixes critical Magic Link/OAuth-state account takeover issue and related auth fixes. Older Better Auth versions are not supported by upstream.
